anchor.description: Exact paragraph anchor supplied in the prompt.

translation.description: Faithful Chinese translation, or an empty string when translation is disabled.

role.description: What this passage does in the paper's argument.

context.description: How this passage connects to neighbouring passages or the paper-level argument.

explanation.description: Substantive explanation that goes beyond paraphrase.

takeaway.description: What a reader should retain after reading the passage.

caveat.description: A source-grounded limitation, ambiguity, or an explicit statement that no caveat is needed.

focus_points.description: Optional source quotations that should be highlighted in the original passage and taught in detail. Existing integrations may omit this field.

quote.description: An exact, non-empty sentence or short phrase from this anchor's source text.

kind.description: Why this source span deserves attention.

explanation.description: A beginner-friendly teaching explanation of this exact source quote; formula points explain symbols, direction of change, and a simple numerical intuition.

formula_latex.description: For kind=formula only, an optional TeX representation of the source formula for correct HTML/DOCX math rendering.
